title: Thai PM to push trade, regional integration at Asean Summit
summary: Prime Minister and Interior Minister Anutin Charnvirakul is leading a Thai delegation to Manila to champion a three-point strategy aimed at strengthening regional integration, boosting intra-bloc…

blocks.text: Prime Minister and Interior Minister Anutin Charnvirakul is leading a Thai delegation to Manila to champion a three-point strategy aimed at strengthening regional integration, boosting intra-bloc trade, and positioning Thailand as a premier economic connectivity hub. Government Spokesperson Ekkapob Pianpises announced on Saturday (14 November) that Anutin is attending the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits in the Philippine capital from 14 to 18 November. Against a backdrop of global economic volatility and geopolitical shifts, the Thai premier intends to push reforms designed to make the 10-member bloc more continuous, agile, and globally competitive.
